derivation.assumption: For the SAME counted eligible patches, integer x_i in 0..C, sum B, q=count(x_i>=T), 1<=T<=C and 0<=B<=E*C.
derivation.necessary_total: required*T is necessary but not sufficient; existing saved P=0 remains authoritative metadata, no redistribution inferred
derivation.capacity_semantics: C=65536 upper bound for an eligible 256x256 patch; not ratio denominator or actual valid pixel count

review.existing76_reused_once: pure build OR pinned reader; nested result and pin_validation retained
review.reader_scope: single saved report two bounded reads; no current pixel/label/manifest/source QA
review.new_wrapper_io: no extra file/network reads beyond existing76 reader
review.UI_reason: New standalone module and CLI only; no main/API/QA-comparison/ModelReview adapter or readiness gate connection, no new screen contract.

limitations: Bounds ignore other-class spatial distribution and do not reconstruct actual per-patch counts.
Necessary aggregate shortfall is not future label/pixel/scene/download volume and does not authorize redistribution or collection.
Eligible capacity E<required is distinct from insufficient aggregate B; B>=1280 does not guarantee five represented patches.
Stored eligible/split/count metadata is not current physical file verification or scientific/training approval.
